units: <cite ref="Chullin 25a">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 103a">Sabb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>דחַט קפיזא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="D00435"><he>דחק</he></cite>) he hollowed out a K’fiza (smaller measure) whereas the material was large enough for a Kab.

<cite ref="Pesachim 28a:3-4">Pes. 28ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>כפא דחט נגרא בגויה נשרי חרדלא ונישלוף</he> Ms. M. (read: <he>ונישרוף</he>; ed. <he>דחט׳ נגרא בגווה נשרוף וכ׳</he>; Var. <cite ref="D00435"><he>דחק</he></cite>) in the ladle which the artisan hollowed out, he shall have mustard soaked and shall swallow it (man is paid with his own coin).

<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:11">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>קא מְחַטְּטֵי שכבי</he> they (the Guebres) exhume the (Jewish) dead. [<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:8">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00626"><he>חַטֵּיטָא</he></cite>.]
